manifest.primary_endpoint: Fraction of clean identifiable pair queries agreeing with truth and both references within Euclidean displacement error 1e-5
manifest.disconnected_rule: Every cross-component query must return UNIDENTIFIABLE
manifest.contradiction_rule: Inconsistent residual remains positive and energy agrees with anchored least squares within 1e-8

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap of world-level primary fractions

manifest.observability: Only opaque IDs and exposed numerical offsets/weights; hidden coordinates/edges/queries remain evaluator-owned
manifest.reset_policy: New zero-initialized geometry per world; freeze before queries; no cross-world learned parameters
manifest.feedback_rules: No hidden answer feedback to candidate
